title: Father K takes Tyler under his wing in Rome
summary: Diana Pasulka tells of Father K takes Tyler under his wing in Rome, about c. 2017-2018 at Vatican and Rome, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: and so when we went to the Vatican this priest comes up to him and then they engage and then the priest somehow immediately decides that he's gonna take on Tyler

plain: A professor who studies religion, Diana Pasulka, says that around 2017 she visited the Vatican with a man she calls Tyler. She says a priest she calls Father K came up to Tyler and seemed to decide right away to take him under his wing. She tells it as part of a link she sees between the Church and the UFO question.
